composition_subtypes.role: Computes maximum participants by sliding a fixed-length window over circular array, updating sum in O(1) per shift.

payload.core_composition_summary: The solution uses a sliding window to efficiently compute the sum of participants for each possible contest start hour, taking O(n) time.
payload.rationale: The algorithm iterates over all possible start hours, maintaining a running sum of participants in the valid time window [s, f) by subtracting the leaving element and adding the entering element. This is a classic amortized sliding window technique.
